intro: Perfect for cozy homes, this Aclectic in Pietra Grigia lets you share everyday meals in style. Its patterned top and sleek frame make even quick dinners feel special and connected.

features.title: Sized for everyday togetherness
features.text: Ideal for four, the compact frame fits small dining corners, creating a warm space where meals turn into moments of bonding.

features.title: Pietra Grigia patterned top
features.text: The stone-inspired surface in high-gloss finish elevates the look of your room, adding a premium touch that’s easy to maintain.

features.title: Slanted black metal legs
features.text: Powder-coated legs provide durability while keeping the design light, so you enjoy strength without losing openness.

features.title: Smooth, durable finish
features.text: Built to resist scratches and moisture, the table stays pristine through daily meals, spills, or late-night chats.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Aclectic 4-Seater Digital Printed Toughened Glass Top Dining Table
